text: Quiet Sunday, 240 croissants. I'm tired. Mei asked why I'm always at the shop on Sundays. That one hurt.

I hear you. Sunday sales are lower, but you still gave the team a full shift and kept the doors open for the regulars. It’s okay to feel worn down — you’ve been running this since 2017, and Mei is growing up fast. 

(2026-07-11)
